system.name: CIPHERMATCH
system.one_liner: an algorithm-hardware codesign that accelerates homomorphic-encryption-based exact string matching using memory-efficient data packing and in-flash processing

components.name: Client Machine
components.role: issues the query, packs and encrypts it, and receives the result

components.name: Query
components.role: user's search query to be matched securely

components.name: Data Packing & Encryption
components.role: packs and homomorphically encrypts the query using CIPHERMATCH's optimized scheme

components.name: Result
components.role: decrypted match result returned to the client

components.name: Server Machine
components.role: hosts the encrypted database and executes the secure search

components.name: Storage (SSD)
components.role: stores the encrypted database and executes in-flash string matching

components.name: SSD Controller
components.role: coordinates data transposition and index generation for CIPHERMATCH operations

components.name: Internal DRAM
components.role: buffers written/read data inside the SSD

components.name: Data Transposition Unit
components.role: software-based unit converting data between horizontal and vertical layouts for bit-serial processing

components.name: Index Generation Unit
components.role: compares the homomorphic addition result with the encrypted match polynomial to generate the matched index

components.name: NAND Flash Memory (Encrypted Data)
components.role: stores the encrypted, transposed database across flash chips and performs bit-serial addition for matching

components.name: Flash Chip
components.role: individual NAND flash chip executing the bop_add bit-serial addition command

flows.what: data transposed to vertical layout before flash write
vertically-laid-out data written to flash chips
bit-serial addition result compared to the encrypted match polynomial

content.key_idea: CIPHERMATCH keeps an encrypted, specially packed database inside SSD flash chips and performs the entire homomorphic string-matching search in-flash via a new bop_add bit-serial addition command, a software data-transposition unit, and an index generation unit inside the SSD controller, avoiding costly data movement and homomorphic multiplication/rotation.
content.reading_order: Left to right, following six numbered steps: the client packs and encrypts a query, sends ciphertext to the server, which routes it into the SSD where NAND flash chips execute bop_add over the encrypted, transposed database, and the SSD controller generates the matched index returned to the client; an inset shows the bop_add pseudocode.

CIPHERMATCH follows a six-step procedure to perform secure string matching
introduce a new command, bop_add (bulk operation add)

summary: CIPHERMATCH accelerates homomorphic-encryption-based exact string matching by moving the search into the SSD itself. Figure 6 gives a system-level, six-step overview: a Client Machine packs and encrypts a Query, sends the ciphertext to a Server Machine (CPU, DRAM), which routes it into Storage (an SSD). Inside the SSD, an SSD Controller buffers writes in Internal DRAM, uses a software Data Transposition Unit to lay data out vertically, and writes it to NAND Flash Memory holding the Encrypted Data; flash chips execute bit-serial addition via the new bop_add command, and an Index Generation Unit compares the result against the encrypted match polynomial to produce the matched index/result sent back to the client. An inset shows the bop_add pseudocode looping over 32 bit positions.
summary_zh: 图6展示CIPHERMATCH系统级总览：客户端对查询打包加密后发送密文至服务器，服务器经CPU/DRAM将其路由至SSD；SSD控制器将数据缓存于内部DRAM、经数据转置单元转为纵向布局后写入NAND闪存中的加密数据，闪存芯片通过新指令bop_add执行按位加法，索引生成单元比对结果生成匹配索引并返回客户端，图中还给出bop_add伪代码。
